nameOrigin: small cavity in rock or ice

pokedexEntries.x: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

pokedexEntries.or: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

pokedexEntries.y: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

pokedexEntries.as: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

pokedexEntries.sw: At high latitudes, this Pokémon can be found with clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swims among the icebergs.

pokedexEntries.sh: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon’s body returns to a pristine state overnight.

pokedexEntries.sc: As Avalugg walks along with Bergmite on its back, it comes across pods of Cetitan. It lets them pass to avoid conflict.

pokedexEntries.vi: This Pokémon uses its massive icy body to flatten anything that gets in its way. When it's floating out on the ocean, it looks exactly like drift ice.

pokedexEntries.za: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its enormous frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
